definitions.explanation: A sudden, brief burst of bright light. Used for lightning, camera flashes, explosions, and figuratively for sudden flashes of insight or inspiration.

examples.japanese: {閃光|せんこう}が{走|はし}った。
examples.english: A flash of light shot across.

examples.japanese: {稲妻|いなずま}の{閃光|せんこう}が{夜空|よぞら}を{照|て}らした。
examples.english: A flash of lightning lit up the night sky.

examples.japanese: {爆発|ばくはつ}の{閃光|せんこう}と{同時|どうじ}に、{激|はげ}しい{衝撃波|しょうげきは}が{襲|おそ}ってきた。
examples.english: Simultaneously with the flash of the explosion, a violent shockwave hit.

notes:
Compound of {閃|せん} (to flash/glint) + {光|こう} (light). Describes an intense, instantaneous burst of light.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閃光|せんこう}が{走|はし}る (a flash runs/streaks)
- {閃光|せんこう}が{光|ひか}る (a flash shines)
- {閃光弾|せんこうだん} (flashbang; flash grenade)
- {閃光|せんこう}のように (like a flash — used for speed)

USAGE:
More dramatic and literary than simply saying {光|ひかり} (light). Conveys the sudden, intense quality of the flash. Also used in compound {閃光弾|せんこうだん} (flashbang). Be careful not to confuse with the many other せんこう homophones: {先行|せんこう} (precedence), {専攻|せんこう} (major/specialty), {線香|せんこう} (incense).
